newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian OFZ bond priced at average 95.25 pct.
newsitem.headline: Russian OFZ bond priced at average 95.25 pct.

text.p: A new 3.50 trillion rouble tranche of the 18-month OFZ interest-bearing bond maturing in February 1997 was priced at an average 95.25 percent at auction on Wednesday to yield an average 83.08 percent, the central bank said.
Earlier tranches of the bond closed on Tuesday at 95.39 percent, yielding 82.13.
At the last auction of OFZ bonds on July 31, a new tranche of the two-year issue maturing in July 1998 was priced at an average 89.04 percent to yield an average 139.58 percent.
Full details of the auction follow.
Issue volume 3.50 trln rbls 2.00 trln rbls
The next coupon date for the bond is November 27, when it will pay quarterly interest of 145,799 roubles, equivalent to an annual rate of 58.48 percent, less accruals of 22,430.62 roubles.
On Wednesday, the ministry will also sell 7.50 trillion roubles of six-month GKO discount Treasury bills (series 22049) and offer one trillion roubles in one-year OGSZ savings bonds.
It will also repay about 6.50 trillion roubles in maturing six-month bills (series 22024) and pay about 820 billion roubles in interest on the two-year OFZ bond maturing March 1998 (series 24007).
